```{r}
as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) {
    return(replace(x, is.na(x), FALSE))
  }

  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(!is.na(x) & x != 0)
  }

  tolower(trimws(as.character(x))) %in%
    c("true", "t", "1", "yes", "y")
}

save_placeholder_svg <- function(
    file,
    title,
    detail = "No results available"
) {
  p <- ggplot() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = 0.15,
      label = title,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 5
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 0,
      y = -0.10,
      label = detail,
      size = 4
    ) +
    xlim(-1, 1) +
    ylim(-1, 1) +
    theme_void()

  ggsave(
    file,
    p,
    width = 7,
    height = 5,
    device = "svg"
  )

  invisible(p)
}

save_placeholder_pdf <- function(
    file,
    title,
    detail = "No results available",
    width = 8,
    height = 6
) {
  grDevices::pdf(
    file,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )
  plot.new()
  title(
    main = title,
    sub = detail
  )
  grDevices::dev.off()
}

write_empty_csv <- function(file, columns) {
  x <- as.data.frame(
    setNames(
      replicate(
        length(columns),
        logical(0),
        simplify = FALSE
      ),
      columns
    )
  )

  write.csv(
    x,
    file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
read_stability_table <- function(
    stability_file,
    id_column,
    flag_column,
    dataset_name
) {
  if (!file.exists(stability_file)) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " stability table not found: ",
      stability_file
    )
  }

  stability <- read.csv(
    stability_file,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  required_columns <- c(
    "Contrast",
    id_column
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(stability)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " stability table is missing columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (flag_column %in% names(stability)) {
    stability$selected_stable <- as_flag(
      stability[[flag_column]]
    )
  } else if (
    all(c("Method", "robust_effect") %in% names(stability))
  ) {
    stability <- stability[
      grepl(
        "bootstrap",
        stability$Method,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    stability$selected_stable <- as_flag(
      stability$robust_effect
    )
  } else {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": could not find stability flag '",
      flag_column,
      "' or long-format Method/robust_effect columns."
    )
  }

  stability %>%
    transmute(
      Contrast = trimws(
        as.character(Contrast)
      ),
      Feature = trimws(
        as.character(
          .data[[id_column]]
        )
      ),
      selected_stable =
        selected_stable
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Contrast),
      Contrast != "",
      !is.na(Feature),
      Feature != ""
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      Contrast,
      Feature
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      selected_stable = any(
        selected_stable,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

build_validated_result_files <- function(
    dataset_name,
    original_dir,
    stability_file,
    output_dir,
    stable_only_dir,
    id_column,
    stability_flag_column
) {
  stability <- read_stability_table(
    stability_file = stability_file,
    id_column = id_column,
    flag_column = stability_flag_column,
    dataset_name = dataset_name
  )

  assessed_contrasts <- unique(
    stability$Contrast
  )

  count_rows <- vector(
    "list",
    length(contrast_names)
  )

  names(count_rows) <- contrast_names

  for (contrast_name in contrast_names) {
    source_file <- file.path(
      original_dir,
      paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")
    )

    if (!file.exists(source_file)) {
      stop(
        "Missing ",
        dataset_name,
        " result file: ",
        source_file
      )
    }

    tab <- read.csv(
      source_file,
      row.names = 1,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE
    )

    feature_ids <- trimws(
      rownames(tab)
    )

    contrast_assessed <-
      contrast_name %in% assessed_contrasts

    stable_ids <- stability %>%
      filter(
        Contrast == contrast_name,
        selected_stable
      ) %>%
      pull(Feature)

    tab$bootstrap_assessed <-
      contrast_assessed

    tab$bootstrap_stable <-
      contrast_assessed &
      feature_ids %in% stable_ids

    write.csv(
      tab,
      file.path(
        output_dir,
        paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")
      )
    )

    write.csv(
      tab[
        tab$bootstrap_stable,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ],
      file.path(
        stable_only_dir,
        paste0(contrast_name, ".csv")
      )
    )

    primary_significant <-
      !is.na(tab$FDR) &
      !is.na(tab$logFC) &
      tab$FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff &
      abs(tab$logFC) >= params$logfc_cutoff

    count_rows[[contrast_name]] <- tibble(
      Dataset = dataset_name,
      Contrast = contrast_name,
      Bootstrap_assessed =
        contrast_assessed,
      Features_tested = nrow(tab),
      Primary_significant =
        sum(primary_significant),
      Bootstrap_stable_total =
        sum(tab$bootstrap_stable),
      Bootstrap_stable_significant =
        sum(
          primary_significant &
            tab$bootstrap_stable
        ),
      Primary_significant_not_stable =
        if (contrast_assessed) {
          sum(
            primary_significant &
              !tab$bootstrap_stable
          )
        } else {
          NA_integer_
        }
    )
  }

  bind_rows(count_rows)
}
```

```{r}
read_deg <- function(
    file,
    contrast_name,
    flip_logfc = FALSE
) {
  df <- read.csv(
    file,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column(
      "Gene"
    ) %>%
    as_tibble()

  required_columns <- c(
    "logFC",
    "FDR",
    "bootstrap_assessed",
    "bootstrap_stable"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(df)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing columns in ",
      file,
      ": ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  df$bootstrap_assessed <- as_flag(
    df$bootstrap_assessed
  )
  df$bootstrap_stable <- as_flag(
    df$bootstrap_stable
  )

  if (flip_logfc) {
    df$logFC <- -df$logFC
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(
      contrast = contrast_name,
      sig =
        bootstrap_assessed &
        bootstrap_stable &
        !is.na(FDR) &
        !is.na(logFC) &
        FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff &
        abs(logFC) >= params$logfc_cutoff,
      direction = case_when(
        sig & logFC > 0 ~
          "Up in MSS/TMB-H",
        sig & logFC < 0 ~
          "Down in MSS/TMB-H",
        TRUE ~
          "Not significant"
      ),
      neglog10FDR =
        -log10(
          pmax(FDR, 1e-300)
        )
    )
}

plot_volcano <- function(df, title, file, label_n = 12) {
  labels <- df %>% filter(sig) %>% arrange(FDR, desc(abs(logFC))) %>% slice_head(n = label_n)
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(logFC, neglog10FDR)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = direction), alpha = 0.75, size = 1.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-params$logfc_cutoff, params$logfc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(params$fdr_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_text_repel(data = labels, aes(label = Gene), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Up in MSS/TMB-H" = "#D55E00",
      "Down in MSS/TMB-H" = "#0072B2",
      "Not significant" = "grey75"
    )) +
    labs(title = title, x = "log2 fold-change", y = expression(-log[10]("FDR")), color = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "top")
  ggsave(file, p, width = 6.5, height = 5.2, device = "svg")
  p
}

save_venn <- function(sets, title, file, high_color) {
  if (all(vapply(sets, length, integer(1)) == 0)) {
    save_placeholder_svg(file, title, "No bootstrap-stable significant features")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  p <- ggVennDiagram(sets, label_alpha = 0) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = high_color) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
  ggsave(file, p, width = 7, height = 6, device = "svg")
  p
}
```

```{r}
read_mir_de <- function(
    file,
    contrast_name,
    dataset,
    flip_logfc = FALSE
) {
  df <- read.csv(
    file,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column(
      "pre_miRNA"
    ) %>%
    as_tibble()

  required_columns <- c(
    "logFC",
    "FDR",
    "bootstrap_assessed",
    "bootstrap_stable"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(df)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing columns in ",
      file,
      ": ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  df$bootstrap_assessed <- as_flag(
    df$bootstrap_assessed
  )
  df$bootstrap_stable <- as_flag(
    df$bootstrap_stable
  )

  if (flip_logfc) {
    df$logFC <- -df$logFC
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(
      contrast = contrast_name,
      dataset = dataset,
      sig =
        bootstrap_assessed &
        bootstrap_stable &
        !is.na(FDR) &
        !is.na(logFC) &
        FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff &
        abs(logFC) >= params$logfc_cutoff,
      direction = case_when(
        sig & logFC > 0 ~
          "Up in MSS/TMB-H",
        sig & logFC < 0 ~
          "Down in MSS/TMB-H",
        TRUE ~
          "Not significant"
      ),
      neglog10FDR =
        -log10(
          pmax(FDR, 1e-300)
        )
    )

plot_mir_volcano <- function(df, title, file, label_n = 10) {
  labels <- df %>% filter(sig) %>% arrange(FDR, desc(abs(logFC))) %>% slice_head(n = label_n)
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(logFC, neglog10FDR)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = direction), alpha = 0.75, size = 1.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-params$logfc_cutoff, params$logfc_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(params$fdr_cutoff), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_text_repel(data = labels, aes(label = pre_miRNA), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Up in MSS/TMB-H" = "#D55E00", "Down in MSS/TMB-H" = "#0072B2", "Not significant" = "grey75")) +
    labs(title = title, x = "log2 fold-change", y = expression(-log[10]("FDR")), color = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "top")
  ggsave(file, p, width = 6.5, height = 5.2, device = "svg")
}
```

```{r}
shared_premir <- unique(

extract_model_expression <- function(
    model_file,
    clinical_file,
    dataset_name,
    selected_features
) {
  if (
    !file.exists(model_file) ||
    !file.exists(clinical_file)
  ) {
    warning(
      dataset_name,
      ": model or clinical file is missing."
    )
    return(tibble())
  }

  model <- readRDS(
    model_file
  )

  if (
    is.null(model$y) ||
    is.null(model$y$counts)
  ) {
    warning(
      dataset_name,
      ": primary model does not contain a DGEList in model$y."
    )
    return(tibble())
  }

  clinical <- read.csv(
    clinical_file,
    row.names = 1,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  logcpm <- edgeR::cpm(
    model$y,
    log = TRUE,
    prior.count = 1
  )

  present_features <- intersect(
    selected_features,
    rownames(logcpm)
  )

  common_samples <- intersect(
    colnames(logcpm),
    rownames(clinical)
  )

  if (
    length(present_features) == 0 ||
    length(common_samples) == 0
  ) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  group_display <- dplyr::recode(
    as.character(
      clinical[
        common_samples,
        "MSI_TMB"
      ]
    ),
    "MSI_H" = "MSI-H",
    "MSS_TMB_H" = "MSS/TMB-H",
    "MSS_TMB_L" = "MSS/TMB-L",
    .default = as.character(
      clinical[
        common_samples,
        "MSI_TMB"
      ]
    )
  )

  metadata <- tibble(
    sample = common_samples,
    dataset = dataset_name,
    MSI_TMB = factor(
      group_display,
      levels = c(
        "MSI-H",
        "MSS/TMB-H",
        "MSS/TMB-L"
      )
    )
  )

  as.data.frame(
    t(
      logcpm[
        present_features,
        common_samples,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
    )
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column(
      "sample"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      metadata,
      by = "sample"
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(
        present_features
      ),
      names_to = "pre_miRNA",
      values_to = "logCPM"
    )
}

    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x =
        element_text(
          angle = 35,
          hjust = 1
        ),
      legend.position =
        "bottom"
    )

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      mirna_plot_dir,
      "shared_pre_miRNA_expression_barplots_CRC_UCEC.svg"
    ),
    p_bar,
    width = 14,
    height = 6,
    device = "svg"

}
```

```{r}
premir_to_mature_base <- function(x) {
  x %>% str_replace("^hsa-mir", "hsa-miR") %>% str_replace("^hsa-let", "hsa-let")

  safe_get_multimir <- function(mir) {
    tryCatch({
      res <- multiMiR::get_multimir(mirna = mir, table = "validated", summary = TRUE)
      if (is.null(res@data) || nrow(res@data) == 0) return(tibble())
      as_tibble(res@data) %>% mutate(query_miRNA = mir)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("multiMiR failed for ", mir, ": ", conditionMessage(e))

  mir_gene_raw <- bind_rows(lapply(mir_query, safe_get_multimir))
}
```

```{r}
plot_string_network <- function(string_db, mapped_df, title, score_min = 400) {
  if (nrow(mapped_df) < 2) {
    plot.new(); title(main = title, sub = "Not enough mapped proteins")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  edges <- tryCatch(string_db$get_interactions(mapped_df$STRING_id), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(edges) || nrow(edges) == 0) {
    plot.new(); title(main = title, sub = "No STRING interactions")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  edges <- edges[edges$combined_score >= score_min, , drop = FALSE]
  vertices <- mapped_df %>% distinct(STRING_id, gene, logFC) %>%
    mutate(
      direction = if_else(logFC >= 0, "Up in MSS/TMB-H", "Down in MSS/TMB-H"),
      logFC_bin = cut(abs(logFC), breaks = c(-Inf, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, Inf), labels = c("< 0.5", "0.5-1", "1-2", "2-3", ">= 3"))
    )
  keep_ids <- intersect(vertices$STRING_id, unique(c(edges$from, edges$to)))
  vertices <- vertices %>% filter(STRING_id %in% keep_ids)
  edges <- edges %>% filter(from %in% keep_ids, to %in% keep_ids)
  if (nrow(vertices) < 2 || nrow(edges) == 0) {
    plot.new(); title(main = title, sub = "Network collapsed after filtering")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  graph <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    edges %>% select(from, to),
    directed = FALSE,
    vertices = vertices %>% transmute(name = STRING_id, gene, direction, logFC_bin)
  )
  p <- ggraph::ggraph(graph, layout = "fr") +
    ggraph::geom_edge_link(alpha = 0.25, colour = "grey70") +
    ggraph::geom_node_point(aes(size = logFC_bin, fill = direction), shape = 21, colour = "black") +
    ggraph::geom_node_text(aes(label = gene), repel = TRUE, size = 3.2, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up in MSS/TMB-H" = "#ff8f8f", "Down in MSS/TMB-H" = "#74aeff")) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c("< 0.5" = 3.5, "0.5-1" = 6, "1-2" = 9, "2-3" = 12, ">= 3" = 15)) +
    labs(title = title, fill = "Direction", size = "|logFC|") +
    theme_void() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), legend.position = "bottom")
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
contrast <- "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L"
selected_pathways <- c(
  "HALLMARK_KRAS_SIGNALING_DN",
  "HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING",
  "HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT",
  "HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS"
)

string_all_pdf <- file.path(string_out_dir, paste0("all_", contrast, ".pdf"))
string_by_path_pdf <- file.path(string_out_dir, paste0("by_pathway_", contrast, ".pdf"))

if (!params$run_stringdb || !all(vapply(c("STRINGdb", "igraph", "ggraph"), requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE))) {
  save_placeholder_pdf(string_all_pdf, "STRING network", "STRING analysis disabled or packages missing")
  save_placeholder_pdf(string_by_path_pdf, "STRING networks by pathway", "STRING analysis disabled or packages missing")
} else {
  dge <- read.csv(file.path(stable_crc_de_dir, paste0(contrast, ".csv")), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    filter(bootstrap_stable, FDR < params$fdr_cutoff)

  hallmark <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H") %>%
    filter(gs_name %in% selected_pathways) %>%
    select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
  selected <- inner_join(dge, hallmark, by = c("gene" = "gene_symbol"))

  string_db <- tryCatch(
    STRINGdb::STRINGdb$new(version = "11.5", species = 9606, score_threshold = 400),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(string_db) || nrow(selected) == 0) {
    save_placeholder_pdf(string_all_pdf, "STRING network", "No stable selected genes or STRING initialization failed")
    save_placeholder_pdf(string_by_path_pdf, "STRING networks by pathway", "No stable selected genes or STRING initialization failed")
  } else {
    mapped <- tryCatch(
      string_db$map(selected, "gene", removeUnmappedRows = TRUE),
      error = function(e) data.frame()
    )

    grDevices::pdf(string_all_pdf, width = 16, height = 12)
    plot_string_network(string_db, mapped, sprintf("STRING network: %s (n=%d proteins)", contrast, nrow(mapped)))
    grDevices::dev.off()

    grDevices::pdf(string_by_path_pdf, width = 8, height = 6)
    for (pw in selected_pathways) {
      sub <- mapped[mapped$gs_name == pw, , drop = FALSE]
      plot_string_network(string_db, sub, sprintf("%s (n=%d proteins)", pw, nrow(sub)))
    }
    grDevices::dev.off()
  }
}
```
